rows.grounds: instrumental of dṛṣṭi plus eva, indicating sight alone as means
repeated instrumental of dṛṣṭi plus eva
third singular middle present of kṛ

items.question: How can the practitioner attract and subjugate the world by sight alone?
premises: sight alone brings the world under control
items.inference: The verse teaches that visual power alone suffices for attraction and subjugation.
uncertainties: whether vaśam implies full control or ritual subjugation
items.plain_english: By sight alone one attracts the world; by sight alone one brings it under control.
